title: Profile picture - white tank and blue jeans portrait

concept.title: Profile picture - white tank and blue jeans portrait

scenes.visualPrompt: Still portrait photograph for a social media profile picture, waist-up framing, subject centred with comfortable space above the head so it crops cleanly to a circle. She wears a fitted white ribbed cotton tank top tucked into high-waisted mid-blue denim jeans, the denim waistband and a hint of the button fly visible at the bottom of the frame. She stands relaxed with one hand lightly resting at the jean pocket, shoulders slightly angled, looking directly into the lens with a warm, easy, genuine smile. Plain warm off-white wall backdrop, soft diffused late-morning window light from one side, gentle natural shadows, true-to-life colour with the white top bright and clean and the denim a rich blue. Shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the eyes, clean minimal styling, friendly and approachable mood, editorial lifestyle photography. No text, no logos, no jewellery branding, no props.

Alternate still portrait photograph for a social media profile picture, waist-up framing, subject centred with space above the head for a circular crop. She wears a fitted white ribbed cotton tank top tucked into high-waisted mid-blue denim jeans, the waistband visible at the bottom of the frame. She is outdoors on a quiet leafy street during golden hour, warm low sunlight glowing softly from behind and to the side, the background softly blurred greenery with gentle bokeh. She looks into the lens with a relaxed, warm smile, one hand casually hooked at the front pocket of her jeans. Natural warm tones, the white top catching the light, the denim a deep true blue, crisp focus on the eyes, shallow depth of field, effortless and friendly lifestyle mood. No text, no signage, no logos, no props.

flow.characterPrompt:
CHARACTER REFERENCE (use the attached image as the exact likeness):
A young Indian woman in her mid-twenties with long dark brown hair, loosely waved and falling past her shoulders, parted slightly off-centre. Warm medium skin tone, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, full defined eyebrows, high cheekbones, a softly rounded jaw and a natural warm smile. Slim build, average height.

VOICE: Warm, bright young female voice with a natural Indian English accent, medium pitch, clear unforced pronunciation, conversational rather than presentational. Speaks natural Hinglish, switching easily between Hindi and English. Sounds like a friend talking to camera, not a voice-over. Lively pitch variation, genuine enthusiasm, natural pauses. Never flat, never salesy.
She should always be speaking in hinglish that is mix of english and hindi

This is a fully AI-generated fictional character. No real person, celebrity or
public figure is depicted, referenced or named. Keep her face, hair, skin tone
and marks identical in every shot.
